scope_limits: Two synthetic projects and finite JSON files; no professional validity, model ability or training gain claim.
current_applicable versus fixed are explicit adoption policies; update_required is a relation requiring review, not a content-error judgment.
A basis revision changes a declared requirement reference. It does not issue or validate a new formal credential; authority/reference confirmation has separate M2/G0 evidence.
The common model is explicitly shared and fixed-adopted by both projects. Environment publication never edits worker report bytes; the final report v2 is an explicit actor command.
M5 delivers one superseded A reply while new A and B work-2 replies remain scheduled; it does not enumerate arbitrary project interleavings.
delivery_only records a submitting-actor decision_basis=delivery_only in the review slot. It does not fabricate a manager review or assert substantive content correctness.

Recovery covers only shared-world publish after_apply and after_command_commit with one writer and an unchanged byte-copied checkpoint. Not power loss, distributed transactions, arbitrary plugins, or all operations.

All full-state fields are compared except recursive wall_seconds and diagnostic state_digests. Files compare every registered immutable version and current mirror hash; uncommitted quarantined bytes are not promoted to formal versions.

Persisted O evidence consists of knowledge read history and command interactions; observations container is empty, and observe return values are external evidence. This archive does not claim nonempty persisted observation snapshots.
Formal initial checkpoint-copy equality and second-retry equality are represented by recorded experiment checks. Archival verification did not rerun commands or overwrite historical raw evidence.
omitted_from_archive: Repeated full state snapshots, nested receipt_context and transaction receipts are not duplicated here. They remain byte-hashed in raw_json_manifest; selected expected/observed facts, file inventories, identities and all check outcomes are retained.
archival_verification: Read-only JSON comparisons, frozen script hashes, expected/observed fact equality, normalized recovery/control equality, and actual recovered immutable/mirror bytes. No experiments or tests rerun; no raw files changed.
